title: Live Sync : Matching the version
content:
Hi,  
  
Regarding matching the versions of CLO and Unreal Engine,  
  
I would like to ask you one question.  
  
I am using CLO 2025.0.148 and UE 5.3.2.  
  
When importing the avatar and clothes from CLO, but I run into the error message saying "There is no Livesync connection.".  
  
Referring to the image below,

![23c2e36aa9fb42d4bafd1bd357b6557b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/ddb5af0e0fc54a94adc6ca1d6bdd055b/images/23c2e36aa9fb42d4bafd1bd357b6557b01.png)  
Do I have to use only the 2024.0.132 version of CLO if I am an UE 5.3.2 user?  
  
Thanks.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi WD_3d, thank you for reporting this issue. It is a mistake on my end not specifying the end versions for LiveSync 1, as none of LiveSync 1 versions are compatible with CLO 2025.0 and Marvelous Designer 2025.0. I will update the documentation accordingly. If you are using CLO 2025.0.148, I highly recommend you to check out the newest version of LiveSync here: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/ddb5af0e0fc54a94adc6ca1d6bdd055b

Comment 2: That's a bummer. For some reason, I have to use Unreal Engine 5.3 or lower versions.Thanks for letting me know.Have a good day :)

Comment 3: That's right, versions 1.1.2 to 1.1.6 are marked as "2024.1.88 and higher", but the 2025 version is excluded.The UE 5.3.2 version must use LiveSync 1.0.0, or 1.0.1.CLO must use 2024.0.132 or 7.3.240 version.
content_description: This page provides guidance on resolving version compatibility and Livesync connection issues between CLO and Unreal Engine during avatar and clothing imports.

title: Exported file looks different in UE5
content:
So I am using CLo3D to make some preset garments for my tool in UE5. However, the exported file looks very different in UE5, as if the textures/lods? are not correct. Am I missing any settings or how would I be able to fix this?

![45bea34772304fea8fc5f983cac82609](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/8ab45c5bc73748af891195477956bda8/images/45bea34772304fea8fc5f983cac82609image.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: First of all, it is better to compare the comparison with the Render image in CLO.The claw screen on the left used wick etc, which affects the color.And from what I know, the intensity level of the Normal Map is imported in reverse. Try modifying the normal map's level in Unreal Engine's Fabric Material Blue Print.It is stable to use the zipper in Texture, not OBJ.You must select a zipper in the CLO and modify it in the Editor window.Other than that, I think it will be difficult to judge only by the screen above.
content_description: This page helps users troubleshoot texture and LOD discrepancies when exporting preset garments from CLo3D to Unreal Engine 5.

title: Hotkeys in 2025 not working missing Download button in Library
content:
Anyone else having issues with hotkeys in all versions of 2025 not working correctly? 

I tried a clean install, importing my saved hotkeys and while they show as being assigned they do not work. Some do work however, it seems random.

I also noticed in the original Library the download all button is missing

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: I hear you, but it can also be situational. In Zbrush for example I have multiple UI's based on the job I'm doing that only have the tools out I need. The default UI is always a suggestion to me and as you learn the software you start to tailor it to your needs.Having multiple options is always nice. It allows the user to decided when how they want to use the tools.

Comment 2: Hi Alex thanks for your feedback. A lot of users have actually found that the New Library will give you more screen real estate since it is only meant to be open when in use and then closed when not needed. Then Just using the "y" shortcut as needed to open and close quickly.But also no worries, we know change can take some getting used to and hope that you give the New Library a chance as it will be the one that will continue to be updated in 2025 and future releases 🙂

Comment 3: Hello, thank you and yes there is a reason I use the old library. I personally like it because it is small and compact and on the side of the ui. I use range of motions poses a lot when I work and having the original Library gives me more screen realestate and is easier. I also don't use textures until the very end so I'm creating fabrics and assigning them from the drop down in the fabric properties so I never use library window for fabrics. The new library is great but options are also great.If I download an asset from the new library I believe it does show up in the old, I'm 99.9% sure but I reverted back to 2024 so I cannot verify.

Comment 4: Hi! We have reached out to our team about the shortcut keys. We will let you know when we have more information about that.We do recommend trying the New Library. Or is there a specific reason you do not want to use it? but also if you go to the New Library and download the assets there and go back to the old Library are you then able to see the assets?
content_description: A forum page for users to discuss and troubleshoot hotkey functionality issues and missing features in the 2025 software version.
